text.label: Heading: Seconds, not hours.
text.value: Seconds, not hours.

text.label: Text: Someone with a problem right now fills in your…
text.value: Someone who wants what you teach sends a DM or fills in your form, and then waits. Think about what it took to get that person there. They watched your clips, maybe for months. They listened to you. They finally decided to raise a hand. Getting a stranger to that point is the hardest part of this whole business, and you already did it. Then the clock starts. Most people answer in hours. Some answer the next day. By then that person has already bought from somebody else.

text.label: Text: And you never find out. Nobody writes down the…
text.value: And you never find out. Nobody writes down the sale you did not make, because nobody ever knew that person was interested in the first place. It is the most expensive leak in your business and it is invisible, which is exactly why it never gets fixed. More attention makes it worse, not better. Double the followers into a slow reply and all you have doubled is the unread messages.

props.text: This is what happens at 11:40 on a Saturday night.

A message comes in while you are asleep, on stage, or having dinner. It is a real question from a real buyer, sent at the exact moment they made up their mind. Nobody on your team sees it until Monday. Nobody did anything wrong. People sleep, and people take weekends. But the buyer did not wait for Monday. By then they have bought from someone else.

props.caption: An illustration of the exchange, not a follower's real thread. The point is the timing: the reply goes out in under a minute, every time, whether or not anyone is awake.

messages.text: Hi, I just finished your book. Is your coaching program still open? What does it cost?
Yes, enrolment is open. It depends on which track fits you, so let me ask two quick things and I can point you to the right one.
First, are you just getting started or already selling? And would you rather work in the group or one-on-one?
Already selling, and the group is fine.
Perfect, that is the group program. I can book you a call Thursday at 8am or Friday at 10am. Which is easier?
Thursday works. Thank you, I did not expect an answer at this hour.

text.label: Text: Minute by minute
text.value: Minute by minute

text.label: Heading: The same message, on two different Saturday nights.
text.value: The same message, on two different Saturday nights.

text.label: Text: Start with today.
text.value: Start with today.

text.label: Text: A woman has followed you for months. She has watched your cl
text.value: A woman has followed you for months. She has watched your clips. Maybe she read your e-book or heard an episode of your podcast. At 11:40 on a Saturday night she finally makes up her mind and sends you a message asking how your program works. That minute is the most interested she will ever be. And she did not send the question to you alone. She sent it to two other people who teach something close to what you teach.

text.label: Text: 11:41, the way it goes now.
text.value: 11:41, the way it goes now.

text.label: Text: Your phone is face down on the nightstand. Nothing happens.
text.value: Your phone is face down on the nightstand. Nothing happens. Her message sits in your inbox under all the others that came in that day. She is still wide awake, still holding her phone, still wanting an answer. Every minute that goes by, the feeling that made her write to you gets a little weaker. She has no idea you are asleep. All she knows is that she asked and nobody answered.

text.label: Text: Sunday.
text.value: Sunday.

text.label: Text: One of the other two writes back. They are no better than yo
text.value: One of the other two writes back. They are no better than you. They may not be as good. But they answered, and now she is talking to them. Her questions get answered one at a time. She feels looked after. By Sunday afternoon she has a call on their calendar, and in her mind the decision is mostly made. You are still not part of the conversation.

text.label: Text: Monday morning.
text.value: Monday morning.

text.label: Text: You or somebody on your team opens the inbox, finds her mess
text.value: You or somebody on your team opens the inbox, finds her message and writes a good, thoughtful reply. She reads it and never answers. You figure she was not serious. She was serious. She bought. She just bought somewhere else. Nobody on your side writes that down as a lost sale, because nobody on your side ever knew it was a sale. Now multiply that by every night, every weekend and every hour you are busy with the client in front of you.

text.label: Text: Now run it again.
text.value: Now run it again.

text.label: Text: Same woman, same Saturday, same 11:40. This time an AI emplo
text.value: Same woman, same Saturday, same 11:40. This time an AI employee is on the job. An AI employee is exactly what it sounds like. It is a worker that is not a person. My team and I teach it your program, who it is for, who it is not for, and the questions people always ask you. It has one job on this page, and that job is answering. It does not sleep, it does not take weekends, and it never has a full plate.

text.label: Text: 11:41, with the system.
text.value: 11:41, with the system.

text.label: Text: Before the minute is out she has a real reply. It is not the
text.value: Before the minute is out she has a real reply. It is not the canned line that says thanks, we will get back to you. It answers the thing she asked, in the plain way you would say it, and then it asks her a question back. What is she trying to fix? What has she already tried? She is typing again before the other two have even seen her message. The contest is over and you won it in your sleep.

text.label: Text: Before midnight.
text.value: Before midnight.

text.label: Text: A few messages go back and forth. The AI employee learns wha
text.value: A few messages go back and forth. The AI employee learns what she wants and whether your program is the right fit for her. When she is ready, it shows her the open times on your real calendar. She picks one. The call is booked and she gets a confirmation. She puts her phone down feeling like somebody was there for her. That feeling belongs to you now, and it is the first of the seven to ten times she needs to hear from you.

text.label: Text: Monday morning, the second time.
text.value: Monday morning, the second time.

text.label: Text: You wake up and there is a call on your calendar that was no
text.value: You wake up and there is a call on your calendar that was not there when you went to bed. With it is the whole conversation, written down. Who she is, what she asked, what she is hoping for. You walk into that call already knowing her. You did not chase anybody, you did not go back and forth about times, and you did not spend your Sunday in your inbox.

text.label: Text: And if she had gone quiet.
text.value: And if she had gone quiet.

text.label: Text: Plenty of people ask a question and then life gets in the wa
text.value: Plenty of people ask a question and then life gets in the way. The baby wakes up. The phone dies. They are not saying no. They got busy. A person on your team might follow up once and then forget. The AI employee does not forget. It reaches out again by text and email, spaced out so it never feels like pestering, until she answers or asks it to stop. Some of the sales you are missing today may be sitting right there.

props.text: Why seconds, and not an hour.

Nobody waits any more. Somebody who wants what you teach messages three people and buys from whoever answers first, not whoever is best. That is the entire contest, and it is decided before most people have opened their inbox. It has nothing to do with how hard you or your team work. A person can only answer when they are free. Buyers send messages when they are free, and that means nights and weekends. Those two clocks never line up. The only fix is an answer that goes out the moment the message arrives, every single time.
Nights, weekends, holidays, while you are busy with the client in front of you. The reply does not depend on anyone being free.
The second and third follow-up go out on their own. That is where most of the recovered sales come from.
It installs into your current setup.

text.label: Text: It is built for your program and nobody else's. Before it ta
text.value: It is built for your program and nobody else's. Before it talks to a single follower, my team and I sit down with you and learn how you explain what you do. We learn the questions people ask you over and over, the answers you give, and the kind of person your program is right for. Then we teach all of that to your AI employee. When it answers, it sounds like your business, because it learned from you.

text.label: Text: Every door is covered.
text.value: Every door is covered.

text.label: Text: People reach you in more ways than you think. A DM on one pl
text.value: People reach you in more ways than you think. A DM on one platform. A comment under a clip on another. The form on your website. A reply to an email. Today each of those is a separate place somebody has to remember to check. We connect them so the same AI employee answers all of them, to the same standard, in seconds. It does not matter which door a buyer walks through. Somebody is standing there.

text.label: Text: It sorts as it goes.
text.value: It sorts as it goes.

text.label: Text: Not everybody who messages you is ready to buy, and that is
text.value: Not everybody who messages you is ready to buy, and that is fine. Some are ready today. Some are curious and need more time. Some are not a fit at all. The AI employee asks a few plain questions and finds out which one it is talking to. The ready ones get your calendar. The curious ones get a helpful answer and stay in touch. That is the sort, sift and funnel part of the Revenue Engine, happening one conversation at a time.

text.label: Text: The call lands on your calendar.
text.value: The call lands on your calendar.

text.label: Text: It works off your real calendar and the hours you choose. Th
text.value: It works off your real calendar and the hours you choose. The buyer sees the open times, picks one and it is booked right there in the conversation. No back and forth. No message that says does Thursday work, followed by two days of silence. You and your team only see the finished result, which is a name, a time and the reason they want to talk.

text.label: Text: Your team gets the whole story.
text.value: Your team gets the whole story.

text.label: Text: Some conversations need a person. When that happens, the rig
text.value: Some conversations need a person. When that happens, the right person on your small team gets it handed over with everything already written down. They do not have to ask the buyer to repeat a word. They read what was said, pick up where the AI employee left off, and the buyer never feels dropped. Your people spend their time on conversations that need a human, and nothing else.

text.label: Text: A record of every one.
text.value: A record of every one.

text.label: Text: Every message is written down the second it arrives. For the
text.value: Every message is written down the second it arrives. For the first time you can see how many people asked about your program this week, how fast each one was answered, how many booked a call and what they wanted to know. Most coaches, authors and influencers have never had that number in front of them. Once you can see it, you stop guessing about what your audience is worth.

text.label: Text: What you have to do.
text.value: What you have to do.

text.label: Text: At the start, you talk and we listen. You tell us about your
text.value: At the start, you talk and we listen. You tell us about your program, your buyers and the hours you want to take calls. You look over how your AI employee answers and tell us where it does not sound like you yet. After it is running, your part is simple. You show up for the calls on your calendar and you do what you are already great at.

text.label: Text: What my team and I do.
text.value: What my team and I do.

text.label: Text: We build it, connect it to your website, your calendar and y
text.value: We build it, connect it to your website, your calendar and your social pages, and keep it running. We read the conversations. When a follower asks something your AI employee has not heard before, we teach it the answer, so the next person gets a better reply. That is what we mean when we say it gets better at the job every day. You have a US company with a team behind the work, and me personally on your account.

text.label: Text: What your week looks like.
text.value: What your week looks like.

text.label: Text: You stop living in your inbox. You open your calendar in the
text.value: You stop living in your inbox. You open your calendar in the morning and see who booked while you were busy. You read a short conversation and walk into the call prepared. Your evenings and your weekends stop being the hours when sales slip away, because those are now the hours your AI employee is busiest. The attention you worked so hard to earn finally has somebody waiting for it.

The Automated Organic Content Engine puts you in front of people on the free platforms and sends them to that website. Those two bring the attention. Speed to Lead is what catches it. Without this one, the first two fill an inbox nobody is answering.

text.label: Text: Why an agency answers.
text.value: Why an agency answers.

text.label: Text: My team and I are a modern day talent agency. Talent used to
text.value: My team and I are a modern day talent agency. Talent used to need radio, TV and somebody's permission to be seen. The free platforms and a nearly free podcast ended that. Anybody can be seen now. Self-promotion is how you get seen, and you have to do it whatever you do for a living. But being seen is only half of the job. Somebody has to pick up when the audience answers back. An agency that got you the attention and then let the phone ring would not be much of an agency. Speed to Lead is how we pick up, every time.

text.label: Text: A follower becomes a client.
text.value: A follower becomes a client.

text.label: Text: When the conversation turns into a booked call, and the call
text.value: When the conversation turns into a booked call, and the call turns into a sale, something important has been written down along the way. We know who this person is, how they found you, what they asked, what they bought and when. That record is not paperwork. It is what the next system runs on, and most people who sell what they know have never kept it.

text.label: Text: System 4 picks it up.
text.value: System 4 picks it up.

text.label: Text: System 4 is Automated Five Star Reviews. Its job is to ask e
text.value: System 4 is Automated Five Star Reviews. Its job is to ask every client, student and reader for a testimonial, every time, without anybody having to remember. It can only ask the people it knows about. Speed to Lead is how it knows. Every buyer who came through the door in system 3 is on the list for system 4, and gets asked when the time is right.

text.label: Text: Then it comes back around.
text.value: Then it comes back around.

text.label: Text: Those testimonials go on your website, where the next strang
text.value: Those testimonials go on your website, where the next stranger reads them. So the next person who messages you at 11:40 on a Saturday night has already seen proof from people you helped. She arrives warmer. The conversation is easier. The call is easier to book. System 3 feeds system 4, and system 4 makes system 3 better. That is what we mean by six systems working as one.

text.label: Text: The ones who did not buy.
text.value: The ones who did not buy.

text.label: Text: Not every conversation ends in a sale, and none of them are
text.value: Not every conversation ends in a sale, and none of them are thrown away. The person who asked and was not ready is written down too, with what they wanted. Later on, system 5, Database Reactivation, goes back to those people with something that fits. Some of them may be ready the second time. You already earned their attention once. This keeps you from having to earn it all over again.

text.label: Text: Why we build all six.
text.value: Why we build all six.

text.label: Text: Speed to Lead on its own answers in seconds. Connected to th
text.value: Speed to Lead on its own answers in seconds. Connected to the other five, it does more than answer. It takes the people your content brings in, turns them into calls, hands your clients to the system that collects proof, and saves everyone else for later. Six parts, one Revenue Engine. That is what a modern day talent agent does for you. We teach you self-promotion, we package what you know, and we build the sales system that turns being seen into being paid. My team and I build all of it for you, and your AI employees run it day and night.
